beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A public agency needs another way to work when its preferred system fails.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Critics also need tools that do not depend on the authority they challenge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Map of Possible Futures, then test the Constitution of Resilience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read the darker scenarios alongside those proposals to see which freedoms each arrangement risks.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is a book for comparing political designs before one becomes difficult to escape.
